content.value: Consider a rectangular plate of 65 cm x 55 cm with one surface insulated and other surface maintained at uniform temperature of 90°C, which is placed in a quiescent air at atmospheric pressure and at $2 5 ^ { \circ } C$ Calculate the average heat transfer coefficient, if the plate is inclined at 72° and the hot surface faces upward.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year Special Backlog Examination, 2019
